metadata.notes: Summit Credit Union runs the same ParaBank build with its own copy deck and a different servicing path. Everything that differs is below; the flow, the risk classes, the checkpoints and the exception rules all stay in the base artifact, so a fix there reaches Summit without an edit here. Illustrative: §3.7 puts multi-tenant execution out of scope, so nothing merges this at runtime.

s5_read_balance.rationale: Summit renamed the column and dropped the asterisk, so the base artifact's table_cell header does not match. Still located by column and row rather than position, for the same reason as the base: stepping from a header to the next cell lands in the first row, which on a live run read one account's number as another account's balance.
